s: Dattamandala was renamed as Rayalaseema by whom?
x:
The region formerly known as Dattamandala (Ceded Districts) was renamed Rayalaseema by Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao in 1928. The new name reflected the glorious heritage of the Vijayanagara Rayas and replaced the colonial term "Ceded Districts."
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).

s: Dattamandalas were renamed as "Rayalaseema" by whom?
x:
The term "Rayalaseema" was coined by Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao in 1928, replacing the colonial name "Ceded Districts (Dattamandalas)." The new name reflected the historical association of the region with the Vijayanagara Rayas.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
